items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: The only time I ever played the Palace was accompanying Ray Harrison.

ctx.x: See, I never played the Palace, because that was in opposition to Loew's State. And we never could play the Palace, see.
So then we went on at noontime. The only time I ever played the Palace was accompanying Ray Harrison. Ray Harrison later on played the Palace after -- she was one of the first
who went in women to play the Palace. And I was in the pit.
